notes.title: v1.1.1 Update
notes.content:
- Reroll Box : Rerolls gained decreased from 3 to 2.

- Remove Box : Removes gained decreased from 3 to 2.

- Reroll Box, Remove Box, Launch Subsidy, and Scale tokens can now be gained multiple times.

notes.title: v1.1 Update
notes.content:
- Cow : Coins gained on collision increased from 3 to 4.

- Pig : Coins gained on collision increased from 3 to 5.

- Meat : Rarity changed from Rare to Epic.

- Added tokens : Torch (Rare), Bowling Pin (Epic).

- Removed token : Bait Lamp.

notes.title: Pintern Demo - v0.3 Update
notes.content:
The target coin requirement has been adjusted.

The required hit count for the Caterpillar, Ore, Ice, and Pawn bumpers has increased from 7 to 10.

Fixed a bug that allowed bumpers to overlap.

notes.title: Pintern Demo - v0.21 Update
notes.content:
The inventory window displays the number of bumpers you own.

Fixed the issue in the inventory window where owned bumpers’ images extended beyond the border.

You receive removal and reroll items every time you submit coins twice.

notes.title: Pintern - Demo v0.2 Update
notes.content:
overall UI design of the game has been changed.

           (The gameplay remains the same.)

The music, sound effects, ball image, and game icon have been changed.
